About This Tool

High Efficiency Image Container (HEIC) is the default image format on Apple iPhone and iPad devices. While HEIC saves storage space, it is often unsupported on Windows PCs, Android devices, older software, and web portals. Our free online HEIC to JPG converter allows you to instantly transform single or batch HEIC photos into high-quality JPGs right inside your browser. No files are uploaded to any external server, ensuring complete confidentiality for your personal photos.
